Class Controller

java.lang.Object
net.apexes.fetion4j.core.client.Controller
public final class Controller extends Object
Central controller for SIPC signalling transport and reception. Manages the TCP transfer layer, message dispatching, dialogue registration, and notification listener dispatch.
Since:
3.0.0
Author:
@Loong Wan
